Both individuals have orange whistle-like instruments in their mouths. (2) The man begins vigorously shaking the plastic bag up and down, creating a flapping visual rhythm. Simultaneously, the woman strikes the metal steamer rack against the pillow in her lap, her eyes focused on the timing. They both blow into their mouthpieces rhythmically.
